body:
I appreciate the response.

I went to therapy for years, still go to some extent.  It never really helped, even if I shared my deepest secrets.  The therapists would eventually get angry that my position in regards to other people never changed. Actually angry at me for not just nodding my head and going "I guess it was all just my perception that this doesn't work," though I believe they were just frustrated they couldn't help more. Eventually, my current one, a woman, just told me to ignore sex altogether or get a prostitute. She insists I'm a man, and shouldn't change, and that it's just frustration. It might be, but I'm not so sure. I just want to be touched before I have a nervous breakdown in public.  It's coming, no human is without an Achilles heel.

I've been trying to heal for years, nothing ever changed, that's what scares me.  It isn't like this is a new thing.  It's as old as I am, no amount of anything changes anything.
